feeds.title: Regency Tales
feeds.description: Step back in time and immerse yourself in the world of Regency. Regency Tales follows Elizabeth Elliott's ramble along eclectic topics and sources that she uses to write her regency stories. Uncover Regency books, web sources, and places in the blog.

feeds.title: Regency Reader
feeds.description: Passionately blogging about all things Regency. Anne Glover is a historical romance author and amateur Regency historian. Ann formed this blog in 2007 to help other historical and Regency romance readers find the perfect HEA/HFN.

feeds.title: Vanessa Riley's Regency Reflections Blog
feeds.description: Get transported to the enchanting realm of Jane Austen's novels, where witty banter and romantic entanglements unfold against the backdrop of grand country estates and glittering ballrooms. Vanessa Riley is a Regency Romance author and has recently published A Gamble at Sunset part of the Regency trilogy.

feeds.title: Anne Gracie Blog
feeds.description: Anne Gracie, author of Regency-era historical romance. Contains writing advice and useful links. Find out the latest news and information about Regency historical romance author Anne Gracie from her official blog.

feeds.title: Donna Hatch Blog
feeds.description: Best-selling Romance Author, Donna Hatch, engages her readers regularly with insightful thoughts and essays on a variety of topics in historical fiction and historical romance. Immerse yourself in the world of Country Dances, grand assemblies, and the delicate art of courtship, where every encounter was a dance of wit and subtlety.

feeds.title: Candice Hern Regency World
feeds.description: Embark on a time-transcending journey into a world of refined elegance, sharp wit, and undying romance. Candice Hern is a passionate collector of Georgian and Regency period antiques, and shares many of her collections here on this site, including fashion prints, fans, jewelry, silhouettes, perfume bottles, and many others.

feeds.title: Jane Austen's World
feeds.description: This Jane Austen blog brings Jane Austen, her novels, and the Regency Period alive through food, dress, social customs, and other 19th C. historical details related to this topic. Step into the Regency era in these pages where scandal simmers in drawing rooms and romance blossoms under gaslight.

feeds.title: Regency Explorer
feeds.description: Relive the bygone era of Regency history as the Regency Explorer blog takes you on a virtual tour of the 18th century. Discover the grandeur of the Renaissance, the elegance of Victorian architecture, and the unrivaled charm of Jane Austen's books.

feeds.title: Every Woman Dreams » Regency Era
feeds.description: Explore the intoxicating charm of the Regency era, along with a bunch of sprawling estates and the delicate dance of courtship. Every Woman Dreams is the writing blog of Regina Jeffers, author of Jane Austen adaptations and sequels, as well as Regency and Contemporary Romance books.

feeds.title: Heather Moll Author Blog
feeds.description: Excessively Diverted is author Heather Moll's blog about writing, the Regency era, Georgian jewelry, and upcoming works. Immerse yourself in the sumptuous world of Regency love affairs, where propriety is a mere facade for the smoldering passions that lurk beneath the surface.

feeds.title: Jane Austen in Vermont Blog
feeds.description: From the timeless themes of love and marriage to the hilarious quirks of her characters, Austen's work offers a treasure trove for both the casual reader and the literature enthusiast. Prepare for lively discussions, random musings, and perhaps a touch of gossip, all inspired by the master of Regency romance.

feeds.title: Mary Kingswood Blog
feeds.description: Mary Kingswood is a British romance author writing regency dramas and romance titles. In her blog, You can find all the books she's read and her reviews on Goodreads under her pseudonym Pauline M Ross. She also posts details about her current novels shes working on and other trivia here.

feeds.title: Historical Novel Society » Regency
feeds.description: Dive deeper into your favorite Regency books, eras, and themes. The Historical Novel Society is a collective that connects and empowers historical fiction readers and writers worldwide. Features reviews, excerpts, and other historical fiction updates.

feeds.title: Austenised
feeds.description: Step into the early 1800s regal charm with intricate observations of historical sites, artifacts, and books. Austenised is a blog about Jane Austen, life, literature, the Regency period, and lifestyle. Contains historical information about Jane Austen and her family, and friends.

feeds.title: Cora Lee Author
feeds.description: Cora Lee is a National Bestselling author of Regency Romance. When she's not walking Rotten Row at the fashionable hour or attending the entertainments of the Season, you might find her participating in Regency Fiction Writers events, wading through her towering TBR pile, or eagerly awaiting the next Marvel movie release. Stay updated with her newest historical romance releases and online stories via this blog.

feeds.title: Risky Regencies
feeds.description: Explore the intricate tapestry of Regency life, from the delicate art of letter-writing to the intricate rules of social etiquette. Whether you're a devotee of Jane Austen's novels or simply captivated by the elegance of this era, this Regency blog promises to delight and transport you.

feeds.title: The Regency Blog of Lesley-Anne McLeod
feeds.description: The Regency Blog of Lesley-Anne McLeod brings the Regency vividly to life with a curated collection of period illustrations, allowing you to visualize the Empire-waist gowns, tailored riding habits, and dashing Regency gentlemen in all their splendor. View tantalizing historical anecdotes and stories.

feeds.title: Moorgate Books Blog
feeds.description: Diane H. Morris publishes Regency-era historical novels through this website. Her first two novels, Rosings Park and Cousin Anne, are based on Jane Austen's beloved story Pride and Prejudice and follow Miss Anne de Bourgh's romantic adventures. Read publication updates, book reviews, excerpts and other interesting stories.

feeds.title: Author, Jane Lark's stories » Regency Stories
feeds.description: Dive in author Jane Lark's notes and commentary on her latest Regency Stories. She shares interesting insights and facts relating to many Regency topics and also posts pictures and other amusing posts. Jane Lark is a nominee for the best Romantic Historical Fiction Novel 2017, and a writer of gripping, passionate, and emotional historical and contemporary fiction.

feeds.title: Recollections Blog » Regency Era
feeds.description: Recollections' Regency Era is your one-stop shop for exploring the fascinating world of 19th and early 20th-century fashion. Delve into the ever-changing styles, from the romantic gowns of the 1830s to the flapper dresses of the roaring twenties. Uncover the influences that shaped these trends, from artistic movements to historical events, and how fashion reflected the social climate of the era.

feeds.title: Regency Romance with a Twist
feeds.description: Explore a bookshelf of sensual tales, most set during the Regency era and published by Twisted Teacup Publishing. You'll also find updates on research done for book writing, often shared in the form of photographs or travelogues. Read more articles on the captivating era.

feeds.title: The Regency Looking Glass
feeds.description: The Regency Looking Glass is a captivating blog that reflects author Maureen Mackey's profound passion for writing and history. With a keen eye for detail and a deep appreciation for the past, Maureen crafts a mesmerizing tapestry, inviting readers on a delightful journey through the 18th and early 19th centuries.

feeds.title: Regency History Blog
feeds.description: Regency History is where Andrew and Rachel Knowles share their historical research. Rachel writes faith-based Regency romance with rich historical detail. Unwind a tapestry of regency titles and historical book reviews through each post.

feeds.title: Regency Fiction Writers Blog
feeds.description: Regency Fiction Writers, Inc. advances the professional interests of writers of the extended Regency period of England (1780 to 1840) through inclusion, networking, advocacy, and education. Here you will come across the finer aspects of Regency Romance - common character tropes, twists and other helpful resources.

feeds.title: Harlequin Junkie » Regency Historicals
feeds.description: Dive into the timeless world of Regency romance with Harlequin Junkie's reviews of Regency Historical novels. Explore a literary world of dazzling debutantes, brooding dukes, and happily ever afters (with a few plot twists thrown in for good measure). HarlequinJunkie blog is run by Sara, a passionate book blogger, and social media Influencer.
